verdict.rationale: Docs confirm [[ ]] wiki-style linking and backlinks (list of incoming links) plus filtering notes by where they are backlinked to/from, satisfying the core linking-graph story. However, there is no evidence of an 'unlinked mentions' feature (surfacing mentions of a note's title that aren't yet linked), which is a key part of the story. missing for 10: unlinked mention detection/surfacing, independent hands-on corroboration of backlink UI in context.
